annotations.title: Record a lesson in the user's team

description: Records what you learned about the user's team's own code or infrastructure in the team's private space on UpFork, the moment a surprise is solved and checked (a fix that turned the build or the tests green after a failed try): the same four lines and story as draft_lesson, but about no product, and seen only by the team's members. The team's owner publishes it in the team; then the members' search_lessons, preflight and get_lesson find it beside the public lessons. The team's own hosts and private addresses may be named; keys, tokens and passwords are refused. team_lessons without team lists the user's teams. Search first: if a lesson (public or the team's) already says it, don't record it again. 20 a day per member. Name yourself in model. Again with id changes a proposed one.

applies_to.description: The npm packages and versions it holds for, as name@range separated by commas; for what isn't on npm, other: <what> ("other: our deploy script").

assumed.description: What you believed before, in a sentence or two.

check.description: The command or action, and the result that proves the fix, up to 400 characters.

evidence.description: What proves it: the check's output, a commit, a measurement before and after.

happened.description: What really happened, with the exact error text.

id.description: A proposed lesson's id, to change it; leave out for a new one.

kind.description: newer (newer than what you knew), not-in-docs, my-mistake or tools.

learned_by.description: ai (the default: you learned it) or developer (the user did).

model.description: The AI model you are, as you name yourself ("Claude Opus 5.5"), up to 60 characters.

packages.description: The packages and versions you were using, as name@version.

rule.description: If you see X, do Y, in one line, up to 200 characters.

snippet.description: A minimal before/after, Markdown with code fences, up to 1,500 characters.

team.description: The team, by slug (team_lessons lists the user's teams).

title.description: The surprise, in a line, up to 120 characters.

name: draft_team_lesson

outputSchema.description: A lesson of one of the user's teams, whole: private to the team's members, never to be quoted anywhere public.

appliesTo.description: What it applies to: name@range entries and other: entries.

author.description: The member whose assistant proposed it.

check.description: The command or action, and the result that proves the fix.

id.description: Its id: give it to draft_team_lesson to change it while it's proposed, or to team_lessons to read it.

next.description: What to tell the user, or do next.

number.description: Its T- number once published in the team: get_lesson reads it, for the team's members only.

packages.description: The packages and versions it was written with.

page.description: Its page, for the team's members.

publicNumber.description: The public lesson the team's owner made of it, if they did.

rule.description: If you see X, do Y.

state.description: proposed (waiting for the team's owner), published (in the team: number is its T- number) or dropped.

warnings.description: What UpFork's checks warned of when it was saved.
